welcome: Welcome, mortal. Athena's voice reaches you across the ages. Today, you begin the Twelve Labors.

move.title: Movement
move.prompt: Drag the joystick (bottom-left) to move. Try it now.

look.title: Camera
look.prompt: Swipe anywhere else to look around the world.
look.success: The world turns beneath your gaze.

attack.title: Attack
attack.prompt: Tap the sword button (bottom-right) to strike. Strike the training post.
attack.success: Steel rings true. The post is split.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.prompt: Swipe down on the dodge button to roll away from danger.
dodge.success: You moved like water. The blow missed.

ability.title: Abilities
ability.prompt: Long-press the ability button to charge your companion's power. Release to unleash it.
ability.success: Athena's Wisdom reveals a hint in the world.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.prompt: Tap the satchel icon to open your inventory. Select an item to inspect it.

interact.title: Interact
interact.prompt: Approach a glowing object and tap the hand icon to interact.
interact.success: Lifted. The object responds to your touch.

save.title: Saving
save.prompt: Step on the blue save rune to record your journey. You can also save from the pause menu.

puzzle_intro.title: Puzzles
puzzle_intro.prompt: Ahead lies a puzzle room. Read the runes, experiment, and observe. Combat alone will not save you here.

combat_intro.title: Combat
combat_intro.prompt: An enemy approaches. Watch for the wind-up — strike between their blows. Blocking reduces damage.

boss_intro.title: Boss Fight
boss_intro.prompt: A great foe awaits. Look for the puzzle-weakness phase — every boss has one. Athena's Wisdom can reveal it once per level.
boss_intro.success: The boss falls. Take its relic.

relic.title: Relics
relic.prompt: A relic grants permanent bonuses. Equip it from the Hub Town's Relic Wall.

companion.title: Companions
companion.prompt: A companion has joined your party. Switch active companions at the Hub Town. Your party holds up to three.

hub.title: Hub Town
hub.prompt: This is your sanctuary: the Temple, Shop, Relic Wall, and World Map. Depart when you are ready for the next Labor.

overworld.title: Overworld
overworld.prompt: Walk the overworld to find puzzle markers and the boss gate. Hidden chests hold gold and lore.

death.title: Defeat
death.prompt: You fell — but the gods are not finished with you. Rise at the last save rune.
death.success: Resurrected. Try again, wiser this time.

hint.athena: Athena offers a hint. Use it once per level — your Wisdom is not infinite.
hint.no_hint: No hint available here. Trust your instincts.

objective.title: Objective
objective.prompt: Your current objective appears at the top of the screen. Tap it to pin a quest marker on the map.

settings.title: Settings
settings.prompt: Open the pause menu anytime to adjust audio, controls, and accessibility options.

complete.title: Tutorial Complete
complete.prompt: You've learned the basics. The Twelve Labors await — go forth, hero.
complete.success: The tutorial ends. The myth begins.
